title: Description vocabulary
description: For one described element, which normalised phrases give which value of each output field.

prefix.description: Output column prefix: field 'construction' with prefix 'walls' is column 'walls_construction'.

split_phrases.description: Split an element on commas into phrases (default true); false looks the whole element up.

count_systems_by.description: Field that starts a new system when a phrase gives it again; only the first system is output, with the number of systems.

ignore.description: Reason -> phrases that are recognised but give nothing.

discard.description: Reason -> phrases that drop the whole element.

values.description: Value -> phrases that give it. Boolean values are 'true' and 'false'; numeric values are written as numbers in a string.

number_from.description: Phrases with '#' where the number stands; the number is the field value.

second_value_field.description: Field that takes a second, different value instead of raising a conflict.
